seo.title: OpenAPI Codegen
seo.description: Generate Api.ts and PATHS from OpenAPI, alias as T*Backend in entity types only

header.title: OpenAPI → T*Backend
header.description: Strict pipeline: codegen raw types stay in generated/Api.ts; domain code only sees T*Backend aliases from entities/*/types.

benefit_text: Never import OpenAPI schema symbols into converters or api. Alias them once as T*Backend, then map to frontend models.

adapter.title: 2. T*Backend adapter
adapter.description: Only <one>entities/*/types/*-backend.interface.ts</one> may import generated/Api. Export TFooBackend aliases (and re-export enums).

usage.title: 3. converters / api usage
usage.description: Import T*Backend and enum values from ../types. PATHS are allowed in api/handlers. Raw Api.ts imports are forbidden.

eslint.title: 4. ESLint gate
eslint.description: Restrict <one>generated/Api</one> globally; allow only in entities/**/types and shared/api/generated. Prefer not re-exporting Api from @/shared/api.
